description: This file defines the final class 'PolicyErrorResponse' which extends 'AbstractErrorResponse' and implements 'PolicyCommandResponse'. It models the response to a PolicyCommand in the system, specifically wrapping exceptions thrown during command processing. It includes methods for creating instances from exceptions and JSON, retrieving related policy IDs, and managing JSON serialization.

classes.name: PolicyErrorResponse
classes.description: Represents an error response to a PolicyCommand, wrapping exceptions thrown during processing and providing JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this error response.
